verses.text: On the tenth day of the tenth month, in the ninth year, the LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, write down today's date, this very day, because the king of Babylon has begun his attack on Jerusalem this very day.
Tell these rebellious people a story. Say to them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Put the cooking pot on the fire. Put it on and pour water into it.
Put the pieces of meat into it, all the best pieces, the thigh and the shoulder. Fill it with the best bones.
Take the best animals from the flock. Pile wood under the pot for the bones. Bring it to a boil and cook the bones in it.
So this is what the Lord GOD says: How terrible for the city of murderers, the pot that is rusted, whose rust will not come off! Take the meat out piece by piece, without choosing any in particular.
For the blood she spilled is still in the middle of her. She poured it on the bare rock. She did not pour it on the ground, where dust would cover it.
To stir up my fury and take revenge, I have put her blood on the bare rock, so that it will not be covered.
So this is what the Lord GOD says: How terrible for the city of murderers! I myself will pile the wood high.
Pile on the wood and light the fire. Cook the meat well. Mix in the spices, and let the bones be burned.
Then set the empty pot on the coals until it becomes hot and its copper glows. Then its uncleanness will melt away, and its rust will be burned off.
But all efforts have failed. Its heavy rust will not come off, not even in the fire.
Your uncleanness is your shameful behavior. I tried to make you clean, but you would not be cleansed from your uncleanness. You will not be clean again until my fury against you has calmed down.

I, the LORD, have spoken. The time has come for me to act. I will not hold back. I will not show pity. I will not change my mind. You will be judged for the way you have lived and for what you have done, says the Lord GOD.'"
The LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, with one blow I am going to take away the one you love most. But do not mourn or weep or shed any tears.
Groan quietly. Do not mourn for the dead. Keep your turban on your head and your sandals on your feet. Do not cover your face, and do not eat the food that mourners usually eat."
So I spoke to the people in the morning, and that evening my wife died. The next morning I did as I had been commanded.
Then the people asked me, "Won't you tell us what these things you are doing mean for us?"
So I said to them, "The LORD's message came to me:

'Tell the people of Israel, This is what the Lord GOD says: I am going to dishonor my holy place, the pride of your strength, the delight of your eyes, the one you love. And the sons and daughters you left behind will be killed by the sword.
Then you will do as I have done. You will not cover your faces or eat the food that mourners eat.
You will keep your turbans on your heads and your sandals on your feet. You will not mourn or weep. Instead, you will waste away because of your sins and groan to one another.
Ezekiel will be a sign to you. You will do just what he has done. When this happens, you will know that I am the Lord GOD.'"
"And you, son of man, on the day I take away from them their stronghold, their joy and glory, the delight of their eyes, the one they love most, and their sons and daughters as well,
on that day someone who has escaped will come to tell you the news.
On that day your mouth will be opened. You will speak to him and no longer be silent. So you will be a sign to them, and they will know that I am the LORD."
